prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production background ground plate for a playable isometric anime RPG forest, landscape 16:9, highest available resolution.
Primary request: a large lush forest FLOOR seen from a fixed high isometric/orthographic camera, elevated about 55 degrees, with rich hand-painted Japanese animation background craftsmanship, warm dappled sun, emerald and teal grass, moss, delicate leaf litter, very small flowers, earth, roots and scattered flat pebbles. An extensive branching network of broad ochre woodland trails connects a western entry near lower left, a broad central clearing, a northern clearing, an eastern clearing and a small southern clearing; paths loop around islands of lush ground cover. Every path and clearing must be clearly walkable for tiny RPG characters.
Composition/framing: ground plane fills every edge of the entire image, no sky, no horizon, no perspective vanishing point, no large objects. Consistent orthographic scale across whole plate. Paths broad, calm and readable, the central area has generous open space. Thin sun shafts and soft leafy canopy shadows on the ground. Dense understory only in little islands away from pathways.
Style/medium: beautiful detailed painted anime scenery, subtle painterly brushwork and fine natural texture, soft atmospheric sunlight, harmonious warm green forest palette, not pixel art, not photorealistic.
Constraints: ONLY ground plane, paths, moss, short grass and tiny plants. Trees, trunks, boulders, logs, buildings, water, fences, characters, mobs, UI, signs and props will be layered separately in the engine; do not draw any of them. No text, no grid, no panels, no borders, no labels, no watermark.
usage: Unmodified source, mirror-repeated by a native ground shader at local scenery scale across the 4608×2592 world. Separate existing wind trees, solid trunks, actors, lighting and a schematic minimap provide depth and interaction.
